text: Company Material Adverse Effect means any change that would reasonably be expected to have a material adverse effect on the business; provided, however, that general economic changes are excluded.

Company Material Adverse Effect means a material adverse effect on the business; provided, however, that a failure to meet forecasts is excluded, but its underlying causes would reasonably be expected to be considered.
rationale: Forward-looking words occur only in an exclusion proviso.

text: Company Material Adverse Effect means any event that materially delays or prevents consummation of the Merger.
Company Material Adverse Effect means an adverse business change, excluding any delay in consummation caused by obtaining antitrust clearance.
rationale: Closing terminology appears only in an exclusion.

text: Company Material Adverse Effect means an adverse business change; provided, however, that any lawsuit brought by a stockholder challenging the Merger is excluded.
Company Material Adverse Effect means an adverse business change. The parties do not exclude stockholder litigation from this definition.
Company Material Adverse Effect means an adverse business change, excluding actions taken by Buyer.
Company Material Adverse Effect means an adverse business change, excluding actions taken by the Company with the consent of Parent.
rationale: Target acts with consent are not acts performed by Buyer.

text: Company Material Adverse Effect means an adverse business change, excluding actions requested by Parent.
rationale: Buyer request differs from Buyer performing the act.

text: Company Material Adverse Effect means any change reasonably likely to result in a material adverse effect on operations.
Company Material Adverse Effect means any change that could reasonably be expected to materially impair the ability to consummate the transaction.
Company Material Adverse Effect means an adverse business change; provided, however, that litigation by any Person challenging this Agreement is excluded.
rationale: Any-person exclusion encompasses shareholders without naming them; semantic extension needs expert review.

text: Company Material Adverse Effect means an adverse business change, excluding actions undertaken by Acquiror after signing.
Company Material Adverse Effect means a change that prevents the Company from performing its obligations under this Agreement.
rationale: Performance obligations alone do not expressly mention ability to consummate; follows narrow annotation interpretation.

text: Company Material Adverse Effect means an adverse business change. No action by Buyer is excluded in determining such an effect.
Company Material Adverse Effect means a change that has a material adverse effect on the business, excluding an increase in shareholders and any litigation against a vendor unrelated to the Merger.
rationale: Nearby litigation is not a shareholder deal challenge.
